notes.title: Accepting Requests for Playtest...
notes.content:
Hey all,

We attended MAGFest 2024 last weekend and had a blast! We got to show off the game and get some great feedback.

Our booth was setup for 1-4 player couch co-op, versus, or singleplayer campaign. We had a ton of people stop by to play and chat. From that, we found bugs, we found some mechanics were confusing - but we also found that people really *really* enjoyed the game despite the minor snags.

We're posting the build we took there live, it is not feature complete or representative of the final game. If you want to help us out and provide some feedback - hop on in!

On our Steam page for Wreckage you can select 'Request Access' which will put you in queue to be accepted for the playtest/demo. Next week we plan to accept those requests for a week long playtest ending on Friday, February 2nd.

Andy

notes.title: Milestone #1: Store page is live!
notes.content:
This is a big milestone for us -- we got the store page up!

Wreckage is a labor of love to the car combat genre, Twisted Metal, Vigilante 8, Carmageddon, even that weird one where you played as a tax driver in a dystopian cyber future with hood mounted rocket launchers... but it's also a dedication to our home state of Florida where we grew up and call home from time to time. The vehicles are all inspired by ones we've seen here, and every arena is based on a major Florida landmark that we've visited ourselves. The wildlife, the weather, the chaos of growing up in this weird state; it's all here. 

We started this journey 5 years ago, as an on-again off-again project but it's time to take it home. We'll be continuing to work on this throughout the year, getting all of our maps, bosses, and singleplayer driver story campaigns completed. If you want to follow the development, please add us to your Wishlist and give a follow, then head over to the discussions and tell us what else you want to see in the game. 

Thanks for stopping by and checking out the game!

Best,
Jupiter Lighthouse Studio
